verdict.rationale: Vanta's webhooks feature lets admins receive real-time HTTP notifications on Vanta events, which could be wired into Slack, email, or ticketing systems, but the evidence pack shows no native, out-of-the-box Slack/email/ticketing alert channel or documentation of remediation-context content in those alerts. Missing for 10: explicit native Slack/email integration, ticketing-system (e.g., Jira/ServiceNow) connectors, and evidence that alerts include actionable remediation context beyond the raw webhook payload.
